'''Beller''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Master chief petty officer|master chief gunnery officer]] of one of the alternate shift [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] gunnery crews onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. As the ranking NCO, it would fall to Beller to actually complete the firing sequence by pulling the firing lever when the order was given. When the order was received by the CO of [[Superlaser Fire Control]] to [[Destruction of Despayre|destroy Despayre]] as a test of the weapon's capability and the on-shift master chief, [[Tenn Graneet]], hesitated, Beller was offered as a possible replacement for Graneet if he could not perform his duties.
